house.description: Service line of duty death benefits provided for part-time, paid on-call, and volunteer firefighters.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Public Safety Finance and Policy
Author added Curran, Youakim, and Witte

latest_action.text: Author added Curran, Youakim, and Witte

additions: a full-time firefighter or part-time firefighter working for the state or for a fire department of a governmental subdivision of the state or a volunteer firefighter or paid on-call firefighter working for a fire department of a governmental subdivision of the state or an independent nonprofit firefighting corporation
(ii) training exercise that is nonroutine stressful or strenuous physical activity;

(b) For purposes of paragraph (a), clause (4), "volunteer firefighter," "paid on-call firefighter," "part-time firefighter," and "full-time firefighter" have the meanings given in section 424A.001, subdivisions 10 to 10c. For purposes of paragraph (a), clause (4), items (i) and (ii), "nonroutine stressful or strenuous physical" excludes actions of a clerical, administrative, or nonmanual nature.
deletions: an individual employed on a full-time basis by the state or by a fire department of a governmental subdivision of the state
(5) a legally enrolled member of a volunteer fire department or member of an independent nonprofit firefighting corporation who is engaged in the hazards of firefighting;
